problem_type: Agent loop completion is published before effects, approvals, receipts, and ledger writes settle
symptom: UI can show completed while a provider effect, approval, budget, artifact, or receipt remains pending; retries can duplicate paid work.
direct_cause: Pi agent_end/stream close and provider responses are observable loop events but are not a shared business settlement barrier.
class_root: No single Host reducer defines execution_settled as the only completed transition after all effects are classified and durable writes flush.
affected_population: Provider timeout, disconnect, restart, and reconcile paths
internal_only_reason: Settlement is a Nomi ledger/effect invariant; the M0 plan defines the barrier and exact #223 paths are the evidence baseline.
invariants: All items are terminal before execution_settled.
Approval, budget, receipt, artifact, and context snapshot writes are durable before completed.
Unknown external effects enter reconcile and are never blindly resubmitted.
generality_proof: Every effect-bearing capability converges on Host preflight, domain adapter effect, receipt append, and reducer settlement; making the barrier mandatory covers provider, renderer, retry, and restart callers.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Publish execution_settled and completed only after reducer checks.
Classify provider effect as applied/failed/unknown and persist receipt.
Report loop termination as an input event, never as business completion.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Coordinator currently consumes runtime results and is the required settlement reducer boundary.
ProductionRun owns external task state and must report done/failed/unknown to Host.
UI IPC must consume execution_settled rather than low-level loop end.

recurrence.reason: Every effect provider, retry, reconnect, or UI projection can reintroduce early completion without one shared barrier.
same_class_scan: Searched Pi end/close events and Host completion publication.
Checked renderer IPC completion projections and restart/retry callers.

prevention.invariant: Only execution_settled can transition a turn to completed; all effect/approval/ledger prerequisites must be terminal or explicitly unknown/reconcile.
prevention.failure_mode: Turn remains settling/awaiting_input/failed while any prerequisite is pending; unknown external state is visible and retry is blocked until reconcile.
prevention.strategy: Add a reducer barrier that verifies terminal items, queue drain, approval resolution, effect classification, receipt/budget/artifact/context flush, and publishes one settlement event.

legacy_paths.rationale: Low-level end/stream-close completion is removed as a completion source in the same M1 change; the loop event remains observable only.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The barrier is an internal Host/domain transaction contract; no dependency upgrade provides Nomi receipt semantics.

migration: Existing in-flight runs resume from durable operation/receipt state. If external status is unknown, preserve unknown and require reconcile; do not infer success from a closed stream.
residual_risks: The 18 productionRun gate tests remain red until the shared barrier and gate wiring are implemented.
Maintainer PR #272 comments are unavailable and may add a release-specific settlement constraint.
